unclassifiedFamilies.reason: The deployed LUMI application mounts broad provider, vault, policy, project, sandbox and real-apply APIs beyond the narrow KAIROS advisory bridge; code presence is not authority or acceptance and the apparent mutation surface must be reconciled with the advisory-only charter.
Start, stop, status, trade, ledger, memory, committee evaluation and limit controls form a trading control plane distinct from read-only CEX portfolio aggregation.
A distinct customer crypto-to-crypto lifecycle exists in Telegram, site, Relay token routes and the operator resource; it is not RUB buy or crypto sell.
Registration, login/logout, Telegram account binding, password and 2FA/profile lifecycle are authorization-critical and not classified by wallet linking.
Provider routing, hosted payment pages and multiple inbound callbacks mutate payment truth and require a dedicated trust/secret/idempotency inventory.
Dedicated payout worker, notifier, payout callbacks and operator payout views are a separate money-writing lifecycle.
Address/receive, transfer-request and externally signed broadcast routes form an action lifecycle distinct from linking and native-signing capability.
Rates, widget, reserves and public statistics are a distinct unauthenticated information surface with truthfulness and freshness requirements.
Reviews, promo handling and rate subscriptions are deployed customer features outside support/referrals.
Public/system status, monitoring service and risk-event operator views are an operational surface not exhausted by operator mutations.
Relay exposes a customer-facing AI ask route that is neither the KAIROS committee nor the narrow LUMI shadow advisory contract.
Exchange registry discovery, detail and draft-building routes form an adapter-onboarding lifecycle separate from a connected read-only portfolio.

limitations: Static deployed-source enumeration proves route/code presence, not reachability, authorization correctness or lifecycle acceptance.
Mounted subrouters and background workers were grouped by product lifecycle; this evidence does not claim every helper function as a user feature.
A generated exact route/handler/worker universe with one-to-one family mappings has not yet been produced; this reconciliation proves material omissions, not catalog completeness.
Nginx-only aliases, database-only capabilities and dynamically registered third-party routes remain subject to their existing E0 trust/data inventories.
No route was invoked and no secret-bearing service environment was read.

independentReviews.finding: The thirteen-family matrix and empty omission list do not prove completeness; require an independently generated exact deployed route/handler/worker universe and retain E0 IN_PROGRESS.

LUMI control-plane, KAIROS trade control, auth, swaps, wallet action, provider callbacks, public information, engagement, operations, AI and discovery routes are materially unclassified; LUMI is the highest-priority authority gap.

nextCanonicalItem: Classify LUMI_CONTROL_PLANE, the first security-critical reconciled family, across the exact six surfaces and verify its authority boundary without invoking mutations.
